name: The things you keep
art: The source lists six original images in site/js/expansion/atelier-collection.js. Preserve comparable subject and material diversity, with optimized but inspectable image resolution.

properties.label: Film-editor contact sheet
properties.text: Balance large serif/sans words on the left with one large selected photograph bounded by perforated film rails. Present six richly different thumbnails in a bottom strip, keeping caption and selected-frame count aligned with the main image.

properties.label: Large mixed editorial type
properties.text: Use large soft-ivory serif and sans words with quiet captions and precise frame counts.

properties.label: Six materially diverse frames
properties.text: Contrast chrome on velvet, a night garden, paper, glass with foliage, studio materials and engraved ink without forcing them through one color filter.

properties.label: Charcoal film and acid green
properties.text: Use charcoal-green #191c1b, soft ivory type and one pale acid-green accent.

properties.label: Restrained film borders
properties.text: Give image frames restrained borders and precise gutters rather than ornamental card chrome.

properties.label: Select, inspect and reorder frames
properties.text: Selecting a thumbnail updates the main image, caption and selected state. Left and right controls reorder the selected frame and disable at either end; the main image opens a detail dialog. Preserve focus during reordering and report position accessibly.

properties.label: All six crops and states
properties.text: Check all six actual image crops and their selection states.

properties.label: Inspectable image fidelity
properties.text: Do not replace detailed originals with low-resolution thumbnails or gradient placeholders.
